denominator.cells: target garment x rotation x K x method
denominator.test_view_rule: exact registered test fold only; never adaptation or calibration

render_metrics.rgb_mae: mean absolute RGB inside target garment mask
render_metrics.psnr: from masked RGB MSE with data range 1
render_metrics.ssim: masked garment crop, fixed implementation and data range 1
render_metrics.lpips: VGG LPIPS v0.1 garment bbox plus 5 percent, aspect-preserving 256 square
render_metrics.silhouette_iou: binary renderer alpha>=0.5 versus target garment mask>=0.5
render_metrics.protected_lpips: LPIPS inside target_protected_mask against Base Avatar render
render_metrics.identity: protected-mask mean absolute RGB difference against Base Avatar

adaptation_metrics.nearest_known_distance: minimum standardized coefficient L2 to four known coefficients
adaptation_metrics.span_error: bound-normalized six-channel residual RMSE of oracle projection versus held-out Teacher
adaptation_metrics.full_residual_error: bound-normalized six-channel residual RMSE versus held-out Teacher

efficiency_metrics.timing_protocol: 20 warm-up renders excluded; synchronize before and after measured region

safety_metrics.identity_contamination: unique test views with identity grade >0
safety_metrics.silhouette_collapse: silhouette IoU <0.70 or manual collapse grade >0
safety_metrics.body_deformation: protected-region geometry/appearance change or manual grade >0
safety_metrics.review_policy: review every held-out test cell without cherry-picking

oracle_metrics.projection_ratio: 1 - squared residual error / squared distance from held-out Teacher to mu_-i
